embeds.title: 📜 House rules
embeds.description: Read once. Don't make us repeat ourselves.

fields.name: 1. Be decent
fields.value: No hate, harassment, slurs, or targeting people. Banter is fine. Being a menace is not.

fields.name: 2. No scam junk
fields.value: No phishing, fake Nitro, malware, or shady invite spam. Instant ban.

fields.name: 3. Stay in lane
fields.value: Pitches, orders, and support go in the right channels. Don't mass-DM staff.

fields.name: 4. Keep client stuff private
fields.value: No leaking tickets, DMs, or other people's server details.

fields.name: 5. Staff calls are final
fields.value:
Argue in a ticket if you must — not by clogging public chat.

Break the big ones → warn / mute / ban. We're not running a courtroom.
